lines.text: Mana opens her eyes, barely holding on to consciousness.
Her eyes dart around as she quickly scans her surroundings.
She's in a monitoring room, surrounded by security guards.
She's tied up, and so is Sugar, who appears to be unconscious.
The head of security is staring at the large monitor in front of him.
He clears his throat,
before shouting into the microphone:

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen! We will shortly begin round five of Coin Rush Showdown!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: All participants, please make your way to the central plaza!
Looks like it's about to start. Let's go.

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Yeah, let's go...
We arrive at the central plaza,
where a newly set-up stage awaits us.
I notice several circular devices embedded in the stage.
Hmm... What are those for? Maybe it's something to do with stepping on the floor...

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Yeah... They look suspicious...

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: They sure do!
The audience murmurs among themselves, but something feels different this time.
*Achoo! Achoo! Ah-choo!*
... I hear sneezing coming from all around us.
The reason for that is probably...

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Pardon me. Would you be so kind as to step aside for a moment?
... all the flowers Flora is planting around Coin Rush.
Ever since she announced her forfeit, she's been planting flowers literally everywhere.
While they're pretty, they seem to be causing some people to sneeze uncontrollably.
The majority of the crowd is giving Flora the stink-eye.
When our eyes meet, Flora smiles and waves at me.
I wave back, causing the crowd to glare daggers at me, too.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Oh no! I can hear sneezing all the way up here in the announcer's booth.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Did Flora of Plan C forfeit just to keep terrorizing the audience even outside the competition? Haha!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Does Missilis's company policy not cover things like consideration and respect?
The crowd erupts in laughter, which blends with the sneezing, creating a peculiar sound.
They're looking back and forth between us and Flora, who is quietly planting more flowers.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: *Sigh* Seriously...?

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Sin...
Don't mind them. We've got to maintain our poise as supervillains.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Let us pay no heed to that certain someone who's causing a nuisance.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Mr. Mustang, if you could please explain the rules!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Oui! Allow me to explain the rules of round cinq: Entertainment Circle!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Do you see these circulaire platforms on the stage? At the sound of the buzzer, you must step onto one.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Each phase has its own conditions! And that is... a limit to the number of personnes on each platform!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Cinq seconds after the first buzzer, another buzzer will sound!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: If you're not standing on a platform or the number of personnes in your platform est incorrect...

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: You are éliminé!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Entertainment Circle begins...

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Now!
The participants rush onto the stage.
*Bzzz!*

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Two!
The circular devices light up.
Everyone scrambles to pair up, each duo stepping onto one of the circular devices.
*Bzzz!*
Soon, the second buzzer sounds.
A few Nikkes who don't make it onto the circular device are eliminated.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: The format is such that some participants are bound to be eliminated.
... You scared me. Don't sneak up on me like that.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Have you noticed that the rounds proposed by Carnation are structured in a way that makes elimination unavoidable?
Come to think of it...

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: In round one, Tactical Maneuver, everyone could have survived in theory...

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: But that wasn't the case in round two, Entertainment Coin Catch. There were fewer coins than the number of participants.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Then in round three, High-Tech Butt Wrestle, no one would've been eliminated if no one chose to fight.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: And in round four, Tactical Camouflage, every participant theoretically had a chance to survive.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: However, round five, Entertainment Circle, is inherently structured to result in eliminations.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Carnation's intentions are clear.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: He wants to eliminate more participants.
Do you think it has something to do with the participants going missing after elimination?

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Absolutely. Knowing Carnation, I wouldn't put it past him.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: After all, I doubt he would've rented out Coin Rush without good reason.
*Bzzz!*

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Three!
The circular devices light up, but their sizes have shrunk considerably. There's barely enough room for two people to stand.
There are fewer active circular devices, too.

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Um...
A circular device lights up directly beneath Guilty's feet.
Guilty looks like she's about to move. The condition is three people. If she remains standing alone, she'll be eliminated.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Guilty! Don't move!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Hiyaaaah!
With no circular devices left to stand on, Mast and Milk jump toward Guilty.
They each grab one of her arms and hang from it.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: W-we made it! Don't let go of us, Guilty. Hold on tight!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Gaaah! Stop moving! Stay still!

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Ugh... so heavy...!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Just hold on a little longer! *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I'm slipping...! Hang on!

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: S-stop breathing so heavily...!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: If we stop breathing altogether, we'll die!

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: *Huff, huff* You can do it, Milk...!

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: I said... stop breathing...!
... Nice.
Wait, no. This isn't the time to just stand around and watch.
Guilty seems to be managing okay, but what about Sin?
Sin is...
trapped between four humongous units.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: I-I apologize. Please hang in there for a little longer.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Oh gosh, you must be uncomfortable... I'm so sorry!
It's like I'm looking at a soft flume ride.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Uh... I'm fine, but I think I'm sliding down.

lines.speaker: ade_b
lines.text: Oh no! Squeeze in closer, Soda!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: O-okay!
*Squeeeeeze*

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: ...Wow. This is fascinating, in more ways than one.
Guilty, Mast, and Milk are all tangled together.
Meanwhile, Sin, Ade, and Soda are all squished together.
... Now this is entertainment.

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Get ahold of yourself, Blossom.
*Bzzz!*
Ahh...! What a shame! They should have made the intervals longer...!

lines.speaker: flora_b
lines.text: Like I said, snap out of it.
As the round continues on,
the dwindling number of circular devices and the shrinking active area put mounting pressure on the participants.
The eliminations keep piling up with each phase.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Goodness gracious, what a close battle!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Let's keep goin...

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Beer!

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Beer, beeeeeer, beer, beer!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Beer, beer, beer, beer!

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Beer!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Uh... oh dear, a drunk has just barged into the announcer's booth!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: P-please give us a moment!

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Beer, beeeeeer, beer, beer!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: I can't believe my eyes! The drunken intruder turns out to be Mana from Plan C!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Is she dealing with the pain of elimination by getting drunk and causing a scene?! Missilis is truly something else!

lines.speaker: mana
lines.text: Beer, beeeeeer, beeeeeer, beer!
... Mana is with the head of security.
That means something must have gone wrong...
The broadcast cuts out, and a brief silence fills Coin Rush.
Sin, Guilty, and I exchange glances.
... Let's end this quickly.
Sin and Guilty read my lips and nod in understanding.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: My apologies! Everything has been taken care of. Now, let's get right back into the action!
*Bzzz!*

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Three!

lines.speaker: guilty_b
lines.text: Bunny suit... Engage mode, activate...
*Clink!*
Guilty unlocks her restraints.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Bunny suit. Engage mode, activate.
*Vrrrrrr*
The wheels on Sin's shoes begin to glow.
Guilty jumps up into the air.
As she lands, she slams both her fists down.
*Crash!*
One of the circular devices breaks under Guilty's attack.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: What...?!
She grabs up a bunny girl standing near a circular device and hurls her.
The bunny girl flies straight toward the Tetra's bunny girl army, who are positioning themselves on another circular device.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Eek...!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Damn it...!
The flying bunny girl crashes into Ade, Soda, and Milk, sending all three tumbling across the floor.
Sin accelerates.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Tactical Tower! Complete!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Wow, I'm so high up.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: D-don't move! You're making us wobble!

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Hey there.
Sin approaches Elysion's maid army, who has stacked themselves into a vertical tower on a small circular device.
As she brushes past them, she lightly taps the leg of Privaty, who is supporting the very bottom of the Tactical Tower.
The tower instantly topples over, leaving Mast, Anchor, and Privaty sprawled on the floor.
*Slam! Slam! Slam! Slam!*
Guilty smashes and breaks all the circular devices.
*Tap, tap, tap, tap*
Meanwhile, Sin forcibly knocks down the participants.
A moment later...
The only ones standing on an active circular device...
are Guilty, Sin, and a bunny girl whose name I don't know.
*Bzzz!*

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: That concludes this round!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Only three survivors remain!

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Wait just a second...

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: All the survivors are from Missilis.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: At this rate, Missilis will be our final winner.
Boooooo!
A chorus of boos fills Coin Rush.
Sin slowly walks up to the edge of the stage,
before crouching down and addressing the jeering spectators.

lines.speaker: sin_b
lines.text: Why? Got a problem with that?
Boooooo!
